challenge.name: The Heatwave Blind Spot
challenge.description: A sudden heatwave has shifted demand for seasonal articles, and the current forecast is missing the mark. #model_monica# wants to automate the evaluation harness to test new weather features rapidly, while #requirements_reuben# wants to keep it manual to ensure every test case is rigorously documented before any model change is considered.

output.content: The feature store hand-over is still done by hand. I would give up automated hand-over if the drift check is good. When the heatwave hit, the manual process let us catch the shift in seasonal article demand before the model retrained. If the drift check flags the anomaly early enough, I accept losing the automated pipeline to keep that manual safety net. It is a fair trade to avoid another blind spot where the forecast misses the mark on promoted middle aisle stock.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states they are willing to give up automated hand-over in exchange for a reliable drift check that preserves the manual safety net, identifying this as a fair trade.
